parsed.name: Keysight EXRxx8A 8通道示波器
parsed.description: 一款 8 通道数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电信号波形，适合电子电路测试、信号完整性检查和实验室通用波形测量。
parsed.description_en: An 8-channel digital oscilloscope used to acquire, display, and analyze electrical waveforms for electronics testing, signal integrity checks, and general laboratory waveform measurement.

actions.description_en: Query the oscilloscope for its current status, settings, or returned measurement values.
